dataset_name: India Agricultural Burn Evidence Dataset (Sentinel-2 STAC COGs + ICAR-IARI CREAMS + PRSC/HARSAC)

sources_accessed.authority: European Space Agency (ESA) / Copernicus Programme / Microsoft Planetary Computer
sources_accessed.license: Copernicus Sentinel Data Policy (Free, full and open access)
sources_accessed.geographic_coverage: Northern and Central India Agricultural Belts
sources_accessed.actual_file_size: STAC metadata JSON + targeted band extraction (B04, B08, B12)
sources_accessed.authentication_requirements: None (Public Anonymous STAC / PC Open Data)

sources_accessed.authority: Consortium for Research on Agroecosystem Monitoring and Modeling from Space (CREAMS), Division of Agricultural Physics, Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR-IARI)
sources_accessed.license: Government of India Open Data / ICAR-IARI Official Bulletins
sources_accessed.access_method: Official daily residue burning monitoring bulletins and district dossiers
sources_accessed.geographic_coverage: Punjab, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan

sources_accessed.authority: Punjab Remote Sensing Centre (PRSC), Department of Science, Technology and Environment, Government of Punjab
sources_accessed.license: Government of Punjab Official Monitoring Reports
sources_accessed.access_method: Crop Residue Burning Information & Management System (CRBIMS) reports
sources_accessed.geographic_coverage: Punjab State Districts (Sangrur, Patiala, Firozpur, Bathinda)

sources_accessed.authority: Haryana Space Applications Centre (HARSAC), Citizen Resources Information Department, Government of Haryana
sources_accessed.license: Government of Haryana Official Monitoring Reports
sources_accessed.access_method: Agricultural fire location monitoring and field validation reports
sources_accessed.geographic_coverage: Haryana State Districts (Karnal, Kaithal, Kurukshetra, Fatehabad)

previous_pilot_audit.audit_verdict: Demoted 6 detections due to failure of dual spectral condition (dNBR and NIR ratio) and lack of field-level bulletin corroboration. Retained 2 detections that fully satisfy C1-C4.

artifacts.description: Normalized agricultural reference events with spectral deltas, cropland status, and bulletin metadata
JSON mirror of normalized agricultural reference events
All 571 spatiotemporal matches between agricultural reference polygons and FIRMS detections
18 verified acute agricultural fire detections passing full C1-C4 composite rule
553 rejected and ambiguous candidate matches with complete reason codes
Comprehensive audit metrics, previous pilot audit, calibration sweeps, and split groupings
